key_insight: SwarmLink adds peer-to-peer coordination to multi-UAV inspection so fleets can reassign work at runtime without relying on a centralized ground station.
engineering_relevance: For photovoltaic plant inspection, this enables resilient coverage when UAVs fail, links degrade, or captures are unusable, improving mission robustness with no changes to the host Aerostack2 core.
method: Non-invasive communication layer that plugs into existing aerial software
Distributed auction for initial target allocation and re-allocation
Unified recovery mechanism for platform failures and low-quality data
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a photovoltaic inspection case study demonstrating that the same re-auction mechanism handles initial assignment, failure recovery, and data-quality-triggered reassignment.
watch_item: Performance may depend on reliable inter-UAV connectivity and auction overhead staying small enough for real-time mission execution.
paper_title: Distributed Coordination for Resilient Multi-UAV Remote Sensing: A Photovoltaic Inspection Case Study
